name: Amount Haircut Margin 1
definition: Information on the cash amount and haircut or margin.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Amount of funds provided as collateral for borrowing the securities or commodities.

HaircutOrMargin.name: Haircut Or Margin
HaircutOrMargin.definition: Collateral haircut, a risk control measure applied to underlying collateral whereby the value of that underlying collateral is calculated as the market value of the assets reduced by a certain percentage. |In the case of margin lending, collateral haircut or margin requirement, a risk control measure applied to the entire collateral portfolio whereby the value of that underlying collateral is calculated as the market value of the assets reduced by a certain percentage. |Only actual values, as opposed to estimated or default values are to be reported for this attribute.
